in_sanskrit.name: रुतुप्रिया
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is dear to seasons/time/age.

in_marathi.name: Rutupriya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Delight, Contentment, Pleasure
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rutupriya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who experiences delight and contentment in life, derived from the combination of roots 'Rutu' meaning season or delight and 'Priya' meaning beloved or pleasing.

in_bengali.name: Rutupriya
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Delight, Contentment, Pleasure
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rutupriya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who experiences delight and contentment in life, derived from the combination of roots 'Rutu' meaning season or delight and 'Priya' meaning beloved or pleasing.
